title: Duplicate `diff --git` file header for goldens/juice.t1
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/juice.t1 b/goldens/juice.t1
diff --git a/goldens/juice.t1 b/goldens/juice.t1
detail: The same diff --git line appears twice consecutively before the index line. A canonical git diff emits one header per file; duplication signals hand-assembly or chunking corruption.
recommended_fix: Delete the second diff --git header so each file appears exactly once; regenerate the diff with git diff if needed.

title: Hunk header off by one: declares -3,1405 +3,1405 but body holds 1404 lines and starts at line 2
detail: Per side the hunk body has 3 context lines plus 1401 changed lines (catalog_hash + ticks 1-1400) = 1404, not 1405. The `t1 1` label (file line 1) implies the hunk starts at line 2, not 3.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the diff so the header reads -2,1404 +2,1404; confirm no tick line was dropped or duplicated.
